SELECT RBRC.ORG_ID , ORG.ORGNM , ORG.ORGNM AS ORG_NM , RBRC.RUBRIC_TTL , RGTR.USERNM AS RGTRNM FROM TB_LMS_RUBRIC RBRC JOIN TB_LMS_ORG ORG ON RBRC.ORG_ID = ORG.ORG_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_USER RGTR ON RBRC.RGTR_ID = RGTR.USER_ID WHERE RBRC.RUBRIC_ID = #{rubricId} AND RBRC.RUBRIC_TYCD = 'ORG' AND RBRC.DELYN = 'N'
AND RBRC.ORG_ID = #{orgId}
SELECT ORG.ORG_ID , ORG.ORGNM , ORG.ORGNM AS ORG_NM , NULL AS RUBRIC_TTL FROM TB_LMS_ORG ORG WHERE ORG.ORG_ID = #{orgId}
